description: Listado de Concesionarios de Radiodifusión Sonora is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Subsecretaría de Telecomunicaciones. Planilla excel que contiene el listado de concesiones de Radiodifusión Sonora otorgadas por la Subsecretaría de Telecomunicaciones a nivel nacional. El listado se encuentra ordenado por región, zona y tipo de servicio. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Subsecretaría de Telecomunicaciones. Its tags are Telecomunicaciones. It offers 16 resource(s) in XLS, XLSX. The portal shows 2015-11-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
